title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Discover what your everyday habits say about your life clock.

landing.intro:
One surprising result.
What age will you get?

about.body:
Discover what your everyday habits say about your life clock.

Your result is a playful age estimate and lifestyle profile, not a medical prediction or a reliable estimate of life expectancy.

steps: Choose the answer that feels most like your real routine without overthinking it.
Complete all ten lifestyle questions in one uninterrupted run.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not predict lifespan, health, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your age estimate and lifestyle profile are ready to reveal.

centenarian_energy.title: Centenarian Energy
centenarian_energy.copy: Your answers suggest steady routines, everyday movement and small choices that are easy to repeat. You make consistency feel natural rather than restrictive.

steady_long_game.title: The Steady Long Game
steady_long_game.copy: Your routine has practical, sustainable energy. You tend to favour choices that keep life moving without demanding a dramatic reinvention.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: Your answers blend sensible habits with enough flexibility to keep life enjoyable. You know consistency matters, but perfection is not required.

weekend_chaos.title: Weekend Chaos Mode
weekend_chaos.copy: Your choices carry bright, spontaneous energy. The plan may change, but you usually leave with a story worth telling.

stress_sprinter.title: The Stress Sprinter
stress_sprinter.copy: You can move quickly when pressure rises, sometimes at the expense of recovery. Your strongest upgrade would be better pacing, not less ambition.

comfort_creature.title: The Comfort Creature
comfort_creature.copy: You value familiarity, ease and a dependable place to recharge. Your sweet spot is comfortable living with just enough novelty and movement.

adventure_fuse.title: Adventure Fuse
adventure_fuse.copy: Your answers have curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to fresh experiences, movement and the possibility that an ordinary day could become memorable.

reset_needed.title: Reset Needed
reset_needed.copy: Your routine appears to be asking for fewer small fires and more room to recover. A calmer rhythm may feel more useful than another ambitious overhaul.

reviewUnlock.title: See what shaped your estimate
reviewUnlock.copy: Review each choice and see whether it moved your estimate up, down or kept it neutral.
reviewUnlock.adNote: One short ad, then see what shaped your estimate.
reviewUnlock.raisedCopy: This answer added an upward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.loweredCopy: This answer added a downward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.neutralCopy: This answer added context without meaningfully moving the estimate.

estimate.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This is not a medical or life-expectancy prediction.

yl-s1q1.question: Your alarm rings. What happens next?

answers.a3: I get up after a moment
answers.a4: I am usually up before it

yl-s1q2.question: You unexpectedly have a free hour. How do you spend it?

answers.a4: Head out and make it count

yl-s2q1.question: Breakfast is available. Which option sounds most like you?

answers.a4: A proper start I actually enjoy

yl-s2q2.question: You notice stairs beside an elevator. What do you choose?

answers.a3: Stairs if it is only a few floors
answers.a4: Stairs, and I may race the doors

yl-s3q1.question: A deadline moves closer. What happens inside your head?

answers.a1: Every alarm goes off at once
answers.a2: I avoid it until urgency wins
answers.a3: I break it into manageable pieces
answers.a4: I focus and enjoy the momentum

yl-s3q2.question: Your phone fills with unread messages. What is your move?

answers.a1: Pretend the phone no longer exists
answers.a3: Work through them when I have space
answers.a4: Clear them before they become a cloud

yl-s4q1.question: A mystery day trip begins in one hour. Are you going?

answers.a3: Yes, if the basics are covered

yl-s4q2.question: A song you love starts playing in public. What happens?

yl-s5q1.question: Your future self sends one message back. What does it say?

answers.a1: Please slow down before I have to
answers.a4: Say yes to the stories worth keeping

yl-s5q8.question: Last one: which future sounds most like the life you want?

answers.a4: Full of new places, people and stories
